question.question:
Equipment cost 65000 USD, depreciated straight-line over 6 years to zero residual, with depreciation charged each year-end. At end of year 2, after depreciation, the recoverable amount is 33% of cost and the asset is written down to it; depreciation then continues straight-line on the written-down amount over the remaining life. At end of year 3, after depreciation, the recoverable amount is 52% of cost. A reversal is recognized only if positive and cannot lift the carrying amount above the depreciated cost had no impairment occurred. After any reversal, other assets total 220000 USD and total liabilities are 290000 USD. A covenant caps total liabilities divided by total assets at 55%. Compute covenant headroom: cap minus actual ratio in percentage points (negative if breached).

Answer format: use exact arithmetic through all intermediate steps, round only the final value half up to 4 decimal digits, and return only the numeric value interpreted in `percent` with no unit label or additional text.

slots.description: Impairment loss recognized at end of year 2.
Carrying amount at end of year 3 before any reversal.
Depreciated cost at end of year 3 had no impairment occurred.
Impairment reversal recognized at end of year 3, zero if none.
